scope: vertical closed-loop GSHP sizing, US only

s1_site.purpose: ZIP code → soil thermal properties (k, alpha, T_g) + climate zone

steps.raises: ValueError on unknown ZIP or service unavailable

steps.on_miss: data_available=False, numeric fields=NaN — location blank on coverage map

developer_pipeline.source: USGS SSURGO SDA API + USGS DS-801 geochemical dataset

cote_konrad_2005.T_g: annual mean air temperature from nearest EPW file

s2_simulation.purpose: building_type x climate_zone → three-pulse ground loads

steps.raises: KeyError on unknown building_type or climate_zone

developer_pipeline.source: DOE Commercial Prototype Building Models (Deru 2011) x ASHRAE 90.1-2019
developer_pipeline.tool: EnergyPlus via eppy IDF patching + pyenergyplus API
outputs_extracted: Zone Ideal Loads Sensible Heating Rate [8760]
Zone Ideal Loads Sensible Cooling Rate [8760]

s3_loads.purpose: 8760h EnergyPlus arrays → three-pulse aggregation (real-time path only)
s3_loads.eq_qh: q_h = min(ground) if heating_dominant else max(ground)
s3_loads.eq_qm: q_m = min(monthly_avg) if heating_dominant else max(monthly_avg)

s4_sizing.purpose: soil + loads + geometry → total borefield length L

open_questions.Q1.1: S_r estimation: Saxton-Rawls(2006) field capacity vs climate-zone lookup table
open_questions.Q1.2: Quartz fraction: USGS DS-801 (~4800pts, needs interpolation) vs SoilGrids 2.0 (250m global)
